answer: Registration requires a settled one-shot micro-deposit. Each applicant quotes a violet — a code derived from their ephemeral key — in the bank memo, and a nullifier burns that violet on first claim, so one transfer cannot back two identities. Every settled line joins a public vine rejecting already-listed fingerprints: issuer token, routing hash, last four. Fingerprints are re-salted each epoch by nebula, a randomness beacon, so leaked tables expire. A farmer minting 1,000 puppets needs 1,000 instruments and pays 1,000 non-refundable deposits, no bulk discount; an honest agent pays once.
